name: procurement-sourcing
criticalInvariants: Sourcing never writes or duplicates Purchase Order, receipt, supplier invoice, payable, or payment truth.
RFQs may only originate from approved requisitions in the same company and branch.
Only approved active suppliers may be invited, bid, or receive an award.
Award selection is explicit and audited; lowest price is displayed for comparison but is never auto-awarded.
Award-to-PO conversion is idempotent and calls procurement-finance through its public application API.
